prompt: A surreal and cinematic book cover for "The Time Machine" by H.G. Wells. The design features a large, ornate pocket watch disintegrating into cosmic dust and stars, symbolizing time travel. The background is split into two halves: one side showcases a Victorian-era London street with gas lamps and fog, while the other side reveals a futuristic cityscape with towering neon-lit structures and flying vehicles. A mysterious silhouette of a time traveler, wearing a long Victorian coat and top hat, stands at the center, stepping into a swirling blue and purple time vortex. The title "THE TIME MACHINE" is prominently displayed in large, glowing, embossed golden letters in the center, with an elegant, vintage-meets-modern typeface. Dark, atmospheric lighting with a mix of warm sepia tones and cool sci-fi hues. Highly detailed, dramatic, and visually striking. --ar 2:3 --v 6.1
